thread:
sara_docs: heads up — opening a PR to roll up function-calling and structured-output examples into one canonical set. aim: fewer duplicate snippets, clearer JSON schema patterns, and a short migration note for integrators.

alex_m: great. any changes that could break existing integrators? want to avoid churn for Dedicated customers. :thinking_face:

sara_docs: no breaking shape changes. mostly renaming to a single top-level key `structured_output`, adding explicit fallback handling examples, and fixing a couple of stale internal links.

jamie: for JS snippets, can we show both the SDK helper and the plain HTTP POST example? different teams prefer different flows.

sara_docs: yes — include both. we'll also add a streaming example and a small note about batching affecting call ordering.

maria: I'll convert the python examples and add a tiny test harness demonstrating robust parse handling (validate -> try/except -> fallback).

alex_m: proposal for the canonical schema example — can we use a simple order API? it's easy to follow.

sara_docs: sounds good. include explicit nullable fields and an example of model returning extra keys.

jamie: here's a candidate snippet for the schema block, OK to include?

```json
{
  "function": "create_order",
  "input_schema": {
    "type": "object",
    "properties": {
      "order_id": {"type": "string"},
      "items": {
        "type": "array",
        "items": {"type": "object", "properties": {"sku": {"type": "string"}, "qty": {"type": "integer"}}}
      }
    },
    "required": ["order_id", "items"]
  },
  "output_schema": {
    "type": "object",
    "properties": {
      "status": {"type": "string"},
      "tracking_id": {"type": ["string", "null"]}
    },
    "required": ["status"]
  }
}
```

sara_docs: perfect. we'll annotate with notes about required vs nullable and best-effort parsing when extra keys appear.

maria: checklist for the PR: (1) runable examples (2) expected-output snippets inline (3) unit test pointers (4) fix internal links to examples repo. I'll mark items as blockers if missing.

sara_docs: good checklist. adding reviewers: @alex_m, @jamie, @maria. also moving long logs to the examples repo per alex's suggestion.

ci-bot: PR #4521 opened by sara_docs: "docs: canonical jsonschema & function-calling snippets" — https://git.internal/repo/pulls/4521 :rocket:

alex_m: quick note — avoid embedding huge raw logs; link to gist for long diffs or regression runs.

sara_docs: agreed, will link instead.

jamie: I found two stale references to the old tool-calling guide in product/guide.md — can I do a follow-up PR to alias them to the new page?

sara_docs: please do. add it to the PR checklist so we don't forget.

maria: small enterprise migration note: if customers pin older model binaries in Dedicated/Private, schema expectations can diverge. recommend server-side validation or an intermediary adapter.

sara_docs: adding a short paragraph in the migration section: "Pinned model versions may behave differently; validate inputs/outputs and prefer server-side enforcement for strict contracts."

alex_m: also adding a perf caveat: batching may change timing for streaming function calls which can affect connector timeouts; include as an edge-case note.

sara_docs: merging plan: wait for reviewers, then merge and post a short release note in docs changelog. I'll update this thread with merge status. :white_check_mark:

ci-bot: PR #4521 merged by alex_m — https://git.internal/repo/pulls/4521/merge (1719001879)

jamie: merged — following up with JS streaming examples PR.

maria: will open the python harness PR next.

sara_docs: thanks all. after deploy, please flag any rendering issues or missing code fences here. :pray:
